summary.zh: 规划视频选题、开场钩子和分平台的分发方式
summary.en: Plan video hooks, structure and per-platform reuse before scripting

description.zh: 在写脚本之前先定视频策略：受众、开场钩子、内容结构，以及一条长内容如何拆成分平台的短视频。适合做 YouTube 选题、Reels、TikTok、Shorts 系列，或把长文和播客转成视频时使用。
description.en: Sets video strategy before any scripting: audience, hook, structure, and how one long piece splits into platform-specific clips. Fits YouTube planning, Reels, TikTok and Shorts series, or turning articles and podcasts into video.
